# Task: ID — title

Status: proposed
Owner role: assign before starting
Milestone: select from roadmap
Dependencies: task IDs or none
Requirements / ADRs: linked IDs

## Outcome

Describe the observable user or engineering result.

## Scope and exclusions

Name files/components owned by this task and boundaries that remain outside it.

## Acceptance criteria

- State a measurable criterion and where evidence will be recorded.

## Validation

List the meaningful checks, device context if relevant, and expected result.

## Evidence and handoff

Record actual commands/results, artifact paths, decisions, remaining risks and next owner.
